items.source: Create a new DriverManagerDataSource with the given standard Driver parameters.
items.translation: 使用给定的标准驱动程序参数创建一个新的 DriverManagerDataSource。

items.source: driver - the JDBC Driver object
items.translation: driver - JDBC 驱动程序对象

items.source: url - the JDBC URL to use for accessing the DriverManager
items.translation: url - 用于访问 DriverManager 的 JDBC URL。

items.source: This SimpleDriverDataSource class was originally designed alongside Apache Commons DBCP and C3P0, featuring bean-style BasicDataSource/ComboPooledDataSource classes with configuration properties for local resource setups. For a modern JDBC connection pool, consider HikariCP instead, exposing a corresponding HikariDataSource instance to the application.
items.translation: 该 `SimpleDriverDataSource` 类最初是与Apache Commons DBCP和C3P0一起设计的，提供了具有本地资源设置配置属性的 Bean 风格`BasicDataSource`/`ComboPooledDataSource`类。对于现代 JDBC 连接池，请考虑使用HikariCP，并向应用程序暴露相应的 `HikariDataSource` 实例。

items.source: In a Jakarta EE container, it is recommended to use a JNDI DataSource provided by the container. Such a DataSource can be exposed as a DataSource bean in a Spring ApplicationContext via JndiObjectFactoryBean, for seamless switching to and from a local DataSource bean like this class.
items.translation: 在 Jakarta EE 容器中，建议使用由容器提供的 JNDI DataSource。此类 DataSource 可以通过 JndiObjectFactoryBean 作为 Spring ApplicationContext 中的 DataSource bean 进行暴露，以便能够与本地 DataSource bean（如该类）无缝切换。

items.source:
An instance of this Driver class will be created and held
within the SimpleDriverDataSource.
items.translation: 该 Driver 类的实例将在 SimpleDriverDataSource 中创建并持有。

items.source:
This allows for passing in a shared, possibly pre-configured
Driver instance.
items.translation: 这允许传入一个共享的、可能已预配置的 Driver 实例。

items.source: Constructor for bean-style configuration.
items.translation: 用于 Bean 风格配置的构造函数。

items.source: Return the JDBC Driver instance to use.
items.translation: 返回要使用的 JDBC Driver 实例。

items.source: NOTE: This class is not an actual connection pool; it does not actually pool Connections. It just serves as simple replacement for a full-blown connection pool, implementing the same standard interface, but creating new Connections on every call.
items.translation: 注意：此类并非真正的连接池；它实际上并不对 Connection 进行池化。 它仅作为一个全功能连接池的简单替代品，实现了相同的标准接口，但在每次调用时都会创建新的 Connection。
